title: FrontMCP Configuration
description: frontmcp.config.{ts,js,json,mjs,cjs}: deployment targets, build options, and the defaults every frontmcp command reads.

$schema.description: JSON Schema pointer for IDE autocomplete.

version.description: Server version (semver). Defaults to package.json version.

env.description: Environment variable defaults the built artifact carries.

port.description: HTTP port (PORT default). Only for node/distributed targets.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path (alternative to port). Only for node/distributed targets.

entryPath.description: MCP entry path ('' or '/mcp'); wins over transport.http.path for this deployment.

origins.description: Allowed origins (`['*']` = any origin). Omitted or empty = no CORS headers.

maxAge.description: Preflight cache max age in seconds.

hsts.description: Strict-Transport-Security. Set to false to disable.

contentTypeOptions.description: X-Content-Type-Options. Set to false to disable.

frameOptions.description: X-Frame-Options. Set to false to disable.

compatibilityDate.description: Compatibility date. Defaults to 2024-11-11: nodejs_compat turns on nodejs_compat_v2 from 2024-09-23, and Vercel KV / Upstash need 2024-11-11.

compatibilityFlags.description: Extra Cloudflare compatibility flags. nodejs_compat is always emitted; list only additions.

displayName.description: Human-friendly display name shown in installer dialog.

longDescription.description: Long markdown description shown in extension details.

icon.description: Path to icon (PNG) relative to project root.

privacyPolicies.description: Privacy policy URLs for external services this bundle talks to.

claude_desktop.description: Semver range of Claude Desktop versions.

platforms.description: Supported OSes (process.platform values). Defaults to the build OS when native addons are shipped, else all three.

userConfig.description: User-configurable inputs, each passed to the server as an env var (`mcp_config.env`).

type.description: Input type shown in the install dialog.

title.description: Label shown in the install dialog.

description.description: Help text shown in the install dialog.

required.description: The user must provide a value.

sensitive.description: Mask the input and keep it out of plain-text storage.

env.description: Env var the server receives the value in (default: the key in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE).

sea.description: Single executable application binaries (not allowed with native addons).

includeNodeModules.description: No effect: the server bundle inlines its runtime packages, so the archive never ships node_modules.

deterministic.description: Produce byte-identical archives across builds (default true).

deployments.description: Build targets; each carries its own server and target settings.

build.description: Build and bundler options for every target that bundles with esbuild.

esbuild.description: esbuild options for every target that bundles with esbuild.

external.description: Packages esbuild leaves out of the bundle (not applied to self-contained bundles: SEA binaries, the mcpb server).

dependencies.description: System packages and native addons the app needs.

system.description: System packages the installed app needs.

nativeAddons.description: Native addon packages: kept external; an mcpb archive ships them in server/node_modules.

network.description: Network defaults recorded in the build manifest.

setup.description: Install-time questionnaire: frontmcp install / configure for node and cli, MCPB user_config for mcpb.

schema.description: Zod schema for the answer (config files written in JS/TS).

env.description: Env var that receives the answer (default: the id in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE).

next.description: Next step id, or a map from answer to step id.

showWhen.description: Show the step only when earlier answers match.

transport.description: Transport defaults for dev / inspector / pm start / pm socket.

default.description: Transport used by dev / inspector / pm start.

command.description: Command that starts the server over stdio.

env.description: Env overlays merged per command (in addition to .env / .env.local).

dev.description: Env vars for frontmcp dev / inspector.

ship.description: Env vars for built artifacts (pm start, eject-mcp-config).

clients.description: MCP client snippets emitted by frontmcp eject-mcp-config <client>.

name.description: Server key in the client config (default: the config name).

env.description: Env vars for the spawned server.

url.description: Server URL (http/sse). Derived from transport.http when omitted.

esmPackages.description: Extra ESM-only packages Jest must transpile.

provider.description: Default provider for frontmcp skills install.

bundle.description: Catalog bundle installed when no skill is named.

install.description: Catalog skills installed when no skill is named.

exportTarget.description: Default target for frontmcp skills export.
